mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads the crossbows as MODEL_BOW + i + 8 from CrossBow{i+1}, so number 12 is CrossBow05.bmd; _enum.h names MODEL_SERPENT_CROSSBOW = MODEL_BOW + 12, and mu.db agrees.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Serpent Crossbow, and the shelf dropped the line for want of a cooked mesh.

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Crossbow, TwoHanded: true. Actions 9 and 22.
fires_note: ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp: `case MODEL_SERPENT_CROSSBOW: CreateEffect(MODEL_ARROW_THUNDER, ...)`. ArrowThunder is not built, so `fires` is left out and src/game/fx/arrow.cpp's modelFor sends number 12 to the steel bolt.
sheet_from: Data/Item/crossbow05.OZJ (128x64), from MuMain, already in the tree as the other crossbows' bolt sheet. The .bmd names crossbow05.jpg on all 165 triangles. The .obj was exported earlier by another session; re-exported from MuMain it is identical.
sheet_note: crossbow05 is gold serpent-scale fittings and a white-and-cyan scaled body, with the bolt strip along the top.

islands.nocked_from: Ten triangles bound to Bone02, the carriage chain the clip slides - the bolt.

release_from: Key 4 of the seven, read off this rig's own tracks: Bone01, the carriage, runs z -116.1, -112.6, -108.7, -105.9 through keys 0 to 3 and then -141.7 on key 4 - 36 units forward in one key. That is the release, on the same key as the other crossbows.
material_note: Six islands on crossbow05, identified by the bones they ride and sampled per triangle. Island 0 is ten triangles on Bone02, the carriage chain - the bolt, as on the Golden Crossbow: wrought_iron. Island 5 (13) rides the limb tips (Bone06, 07, 10) and spans them - the string: leather_wrap. Island 1 (114) is the body and prod, gold serpent fittings over pale scales, mean (105, 93, 57) with 73 of its triangles warm: brass at 0.6, the ceiling guard. On Bone04 with it: island 2 (10) a grey fitting (118, 109, 101), steel; island 3 (6) a gold one, brass; island 4 (12) a dark bracket (44, 39, 22), wrought_iron.
